title: Research Log Archival at End of Cycle
summary: Moves research log archival from the start of the next research cycle to the end of the current one: after the essay is written, citation- and argument-audited, gated, and reflected on, research-log.md is moved to research-logs/NNN-descriptive-name.md matching the essay number, so the next cycle starts with a clean log. If a research-log.md is found at the start of a new cycle, it is treated as an unarchived prior log (likely from an interrupted session) and archived before the new cycle proceeds.
workflow_point: RESEARCH phase, end of cycle (after reflections)
mechanism: archive research-log.md to research-logs/NNN-descriptive-name.md at cycle end rather than at the next cycle's start
